scopeStatement: This decision is a floor/ceiling on acquisition depth for the CC-24 pilot's 15 selected requirements only. It is NOT authority to create learner content, author lessons/storyboards/assertions, or expand qualification scope. It does not authorise pilot-002 execution by itself -- pilot-002 additionally requires a fresh session with no visibility into pilot-001's discovered sources or normalized answers, and completion of any remaining implementation-engineer corrections.

paDepthReview.qualificationPerformanceVerb: perform and apply, not merely define
paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Fraction equivalence, comparison, conversion between fraction/decimal/percentage forms, four basic operations, and straightforward Level-2 vocational numeric application.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No compound/repeated-percentage theory, advanced ratio/proportion theory, or formal proof.
paDepthReview.assessmentPerformanceExpected: Perform and apply, not merely define.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC1.1 identify and apply; Range "Fractions and percentages".
paDepthReview.architectNotes: This row need not absorb every independently scoped percentage obligation.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Substitute values and isolate an unknown through straightforward single-step and simple multi-step rearrangement, including squared/root forms used by Unit-202 formulae.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No simultaneous equations, quadratic methods, abstract algebra, or proof.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC1.1 identify and apply; Range "Algebra" and "Transposition"; public assessment confirms transposition.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Identify and use the correct SI unit name and symbol and distinguish it from a legitimate practical temperature scale.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No temperature-scale conversion calculation, thermodynamic derivation, or metrology theory.

paDepthReview.qualificationPerformanceVerb: explain and apply through simple calculations
paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Authoritative formula and variable interpretation, combined with ACQ-004 (the already-approved foundational transposition procedure) for substitution, direct use, and rearrangement.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No first-principles derivation or expansion into the complete series/parallel circuit topic.
excludedEnrichment: expansion into the complete series/parallel circuit topic
paDepthReview.assessmentPerformanceExpected: Explain and apply through simple calculations.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC4.4 explain the relationship; calculation performance is supported through the already-approved foundational transposition procedure.
paDepthReview.architectNotes: Preserve and expose the existing reusesFoundationalProcedureIds relationship (-> the formula-transposition requirement); do not duplicate generic algebra as technical-domain evidence.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Relationship, variable meanings, units, applicability conditions, and straightforward direct/rearranged calculation using the foundational calculation procedure.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No gravitation derivation, orbital mechanics, field theory, or separate F=ma mastery.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC3.1 specify the meaning of mass and weight; AC3.3 describes force relationships; public assessment supports calculation.

paDepthReview.qualificationPerformanceVerb: determine/apply direction, not merely name the rule
paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Apply the named rule to determine field/current direction for a straight current-carrying conductor, including role mapping and correct-use conditions.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: Do not add coil, solenoid, electromagnet, relay, or contactor content to this requirement; no vector formalism.
paDepthReview.assessmentPerformanceExpected: Determine/apply direction, not merely name the rule.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC5.3 field production plus the necessary directional prerequisite.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Directional mapping, role mapping, and conditions sufficient to determine an unknown direction from the other stated quantities.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No vector cross-product treatment, general-angle derivation, or machine-design enrichment.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC5.3 force on a current-carrying conductor plus necessary directional reasoning.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Directional mapping, role mapping, and correct-use conditions sufficient for Level-2 generator/induction questions.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No differential Faraday-law or vector treatment.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC5.3 electromotive-force/induction content plus necessary generator-direction reasoning.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Formula, variable meanings, pole-pair interpretation, rotational-unit conditions, direct/rearranged calculation, and equivalent use where speed is supplied in rpm.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No machine slip, winding design, harmonics, or multi-phase machine theory.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC5.4 describes AC generation in terms including frequency; public assessment supports frequency calculation.
paDepthReview.architectNotes: Preserve the foundational transposition reuse rather than duplicating algebra evidence.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Applicability to a sine wave, forward and inverse use of the relationship, and straightforward calculation.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No general-waveform RMS integration, calculus, Fourier analysis, or time-domain sine-equation mastery.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC5.5 identify sine-wave characteristics; Range includes RMS and peak characteristics.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: A correct basic statement of the defining operating behaviour and its immediate charge/discharge consequence.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No semiconductor-level theory, detailed transient mathematics, reactance calculation, component sizing, or circuit design unless separately required.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC6.2 state the basic operating principles of named components.

paDepthReview.qualificationPerformanceVerb: state the basic principle and recognise its general role
paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Defining switching behaviour, control role, and basic operating conditions at component/block level.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No semiconductor-layer physics, detailed I-V curves, gate-drive design, snubber design, or exact dimmer topology.
paDepthReview.assessmentPerformanceExpected: State the basic principle and recognise its general role.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Category-level purpose and the minimal functional arrangement needed to explain remote control without a direct wired control path.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No protocol stack, Wi-Fi engineering, RF design, frequency-band detail, IoT architecture, or generalisation from one manufacturer's product.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC6.1 describe function and application; Range "Wireless control systems".

paDepthReview.qualificationPerformanceVerb: identify function and correct basic connection/use
paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Identify the measured quantity and cover both required current-sensing and voltage-sensing connection roles at basic qualification depth.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: No internal construction, calibration, electrodynamic derivation, three-phase measurement methods, or instrument-design detail.
paDepthReview.assessmentPerformanceExpected: Identify function and correct basic connection/use.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC2.3 identify appropriate instruments; Range "Power"; operational topology is inseparable from meaningful use.

paDepthReview.minimumSufficientDepth: Explain the specified component-to-ringer role at basic functional level, with evidence supporting every stated causal clause.
paDepthReview.maximumJustifiedDepth: Do not generalise it to every telephone implementation or add line-testing resistors, surge protection, master/secondary socket wiring, or legacy PSTN detail.
paDepthReview.depthEvidenceBasis: AC6.1 describe function/application; Range "Telephones"; this is a calibrated representative exemplar.
